project.name: com.wxdgaming.batis.sql
project.description:
Database-neutral JDBC engine of wxd-gaming.batis, a lightweight JDBC-first ORM for Java 21. JdbcTemplate creates tables from entity metadata and compares them against the live schema (checkTable) so only the necessary ALTER statements are issued, and exposes QueryRunner for raw SQL, the fluent SelectQuery DSL, BeanRunner for entity read/write, CachedBeanRunner for write-behind batching with single-flight loading, bounded expiry and delete tombstones, TransactionTemplate with propagation and isolation levels, and batch operations with per-row results. The module also declares the dialect SPI a database implementation must fill in - column type rendering, table create/alter/drop/truncate, metadata readers, bean-value handlers and partition manager - and holds no database-specific literals itself. Add com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.mysql or com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.pgsql to talk to a real database. Connection pooling uses HikariCP.
wxd-gaming.batis 方言无关的 JDBC 引擎层（Java 21 轻量级 JDBC ORM）。JdbcTemplate 按实体元数据自动建表， 并用 checkTable 把实体侧渲染结果与库端真实结构比对，只下发必要的 ALTER 语句。对外还提供裸 SQL 的 QueryRunner、链式 SelectQuery 查询 DSL、实体读写的 BeanRunner、支持 Write-Behind 延迟批刷的 CachedBeanRunner（单飞加载防击穿、固定过期防雪崩、删除墓碑防穿透）、带传播行为与隔离级别的 TransactionTemplate，以及带逐行结果的批量操作与 SQL 异常翻译。本模块同时声明了方言必须实现的 SPI——列类型渲染、建表/改表/删表/清空、元数据读取、Bean 取值处理与分区管理——自身不含任何数据库 专有字面量，必须配合 com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.mysql 或 com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.pgsql 才能连上真实数据库。 连接池由 HikariCP 提供。
